derivation.source_geometry: The original ordered LineString coordinates are retained. Only the repeated closing coordinate is omitted in the native route.
derivation.projection: Local equirectangular projection in metres using the mean latitude and an Earth radius of 6371000 metres.
derivation.fitting: Uniform scale and rigid rotation chosen from 0 to 180 degrees in 0.25 degree increments, with a 45 pixel margin. No stretching, smoothing, or artificial corner changes.
derivation.road_width_note: The GeoJSON supplies centerlines, not road boundaries. Widths are simulation approximations, not surveyed values. Monaco uses 9 metres so its close hairpin approaches remain separate.
derivation.road_mask: Pixel centers must lie within half the specified projected road width of a source segment.
derivation.physics_note: Cars use the same source projection scale. The simulation omits elevation and banking and compresses real travel time by a factor of three.
